4d2394ea-d459-4231-a908-7c1fb6e03e93.title: Fix anneal-down effectiveness: entropy computed on allocation_weight but selection uses tickets
4d2394ea-d459-4231-a908-7c1fb6e03e93.description: Observed arena_entropy stuck at ~0.9128 despite annealMode + shadow caps. 4830527b-0389-44ee-8291-1f4ba2edaf24.title: Increase average_transfer_confidence via confidence-aware selection and evidence gating
4830527b-0389-44ee-8291-1f4ba2edaf24.description:
Goal: raise average_transfer_confidence ~0.13 -> >=0.16 while keeping arena_entropy in 0.75–0.88 band and transfer_variance <=0.12.

Plan:
1) Confidence-aware utility: add penalty for low confidence in per-domain transfer stats: utility -= lambda_conf * max(0, conf_target - conf_d). conf_target=0.18.
2) Evidence gating: do not apply transfer impact (or apply scaled impact) until evidence is sufficient: n_obs>=N_MIN (e.g., 5) OR conf_d>=CONF_MIN (e.g., 0.14). Below threshold, schedule extra evals.
3) Confidence build budget: per tick, guarantee >=1–2 transfer-eval runs for low-confidence/high-variance domains (medium|high|low|p5, small|low|low|p5) to increase evidence.
4) Telemetry: add low_conf_share, confidence_trend (global+per-domain), and applied_transfer_impact_share.

70fdad9d-dcc6-4a6f-a662-0136b55b4c70.title: Add per-domain confidence quotas for transfer evaluation (min evals per tick)
70fdad9d-dcc6-4a6f-a662-0136b55b4c70.description: Implement a small per-tick evaluation quota that targets domains with low confidence/high variance (from per_domain_transfer). Each campaign tick, before main experiment allocation, schedule at least 1 eval-run for top K low-confidence domains (K=2) and optionally 1 extra for the worst domain if conf<0.12. Integrate with campaign planning so ticks always create at least one run and evidence accumulates deterministically.

4319190a-9efa-4bd3-a83d-8b4f73f66cfa.title: Add confidence telemetry: low_conf_share, confidence_trend, impact_applied_share
4319190a-9efa-4bd3-a83d-8b4f73f66cfa.description:
Extend transfer_diagnostics/intelligence_meta_snapshot with:
- low_conf_share (fraction of transfer applications where conf<CONF_MIN)
- confidence_trend (delta over short/ultra windows)
- impact_applied_share (fraction of runs where transfer impact was applied vs gated)
- per-domain: conf_delta_ultra, n_obs
This will make it easy to confirm that confidence-building quota and gating work.

a9626805-67ac-41e1-a4f5-240f073025ce.title: Make transfer evidence buildable: track obs/succ/fail per domain and define success for evidence updates
a9626805-67ac-41e1-a4f5-240f073025ce.description: Hard gate now blocks all impact (impact_applied_share=0). Implement per-domain transfer_evidence telemetry (obs/succ/fail/evidence_strength) and redefine evidence success so it can rise with observations (e.g., score >= rolling median - margin, no anomaly, score present). Ensure evidence updates happen even when impact_scale=0 and are driven by transfer_eval_quota runs.

9d1921b8-1455-4432-ad05-e4f77887865a.title: Bootstrap transfer gate: staged thresholds for impact vs replication
9d1921b8-1455-4432-ad05-e4f77887865a.description:
After splitting match/evidence gates, impact_applied_share remains 0 because evidence_strength stays below 0.55. Add staged gating:
- Keep strict gate for replication/migration: obs>=N_MIN && evidence_strength>=0.55 && match_conf>=0.11.
- Introduce 'micro-impact' gate for applying small capped impact: obs>=N_MIN && evidence_strength>=0.35 && match_conf>=0.11, with impact_scale capped (e.g., <=0.05) and no replication.
- Optionally ramp EVID_MIN from 0.35->0.55 as obs grows (e.g., 0.35 at obs=5, 0.45 at obs=8, 0.55 at obs>=10).
Goal: open the loop safely, let evidence improve, while preventing noise explosion.

218c40f6-4716-4002-830e-b2258bc2f400.title: Open micro-impact loop: replace strict success gating with 'not-worse-than-baseline' predicate + diagnostics
218c40f6-4716-4002-830e-b2258bc2f400.description: Current micro gate passes often but impact_applied_share stays 0 because transfer_success_signal_micro_share ~0.04 and micro-impact requires successSignal==true. Patch research_memory.ts: introduce transferImpactAllowedMicro = fitness >= (domainBaseline - microImpactMarginUsed) && !anomaly; use this predicate for micro-impact application (cap 0.05) instead of transferSuccessSignal. Keep full gate unchanged. Add evidence_gate fields: micro_impact_margin, impact_allowed_micro. Add telemetry aggregate micro_success_block_share (micro gate passed but impact_allowed_micro false).

9329b58c-4ee2-488d-90cd-2520dcda4d70.title: Open micro-impact loop: decouple from rare successSignal; use not-worse-than-baseline predicate + diagnostics
9329b58c-4ee2-488d-90cd-2520dcda4d70.description:
Problem: micro_gate_block_share ~0.24 (often passes) but impact_applied_share=0 because micro-impact currently requires transferSuccessSignal==true; transfer_success_signal_micro_share ~0.04.

Patch (research_memory.ts):
- Introduce `impact_allowed_micro` predicate, independent from evidence success update:
  `impact_allowed_micro = Number.isFinite(fitness) && fitness >= (domainBaseline - microImpactMarginUsed) && !anomaly_flag`.
  Use a margin similar to dynamic margin but slightly more permissive, e.g. `microImpactMarginUsed = max(TRANSFER_SUCCESS_MARGIN, 1.0*baselineMad, 0.03*max(0.1,domainBaseline))`.
- In micro-impact branch (evidence_strength between microMin and fullMin): allow impact if `impact_allowed_micro` instead of `transferSuccessSignal`.
- Keep full gate unchanged; replication/migration still requires fullMin (0.55).
- Add evidence_gate fields: `micro_impact_margin`, `impact_allowed_micro`.

Telemetry (telemetry.ts): add `micro_success_block_share` = share where micro gate passed but `impact_allowed_micro` false; add `impact_level_share.micro` and `avg_impact_scale_micro` already present, ensure they’re computed from impact_level/impact_scale fields.

Goal: get first non-zero `impact_applied_share` (micro) safely (cap=0.05) without noise explosion.

f67c7537-8e73-40e3-a5d2-4048ab94d3ac.title: Transfer burn-in: validate micro-impact stability and lift to measurable effect
f67c7537-8e73-40e3-a5d2-4048ab94d3ac.description: Run a 12-tick burn-in campaign via queue with current transfer settings. Collect snapshots each tick (transfer_diagnostics, intelligence_meta_snapshot, arena_telemetry_snapshot). Success criteria: impact_applied_share(micro) rising >0.02 without entropy collapse; no spike in anomaly_rate; transfer_variance trend non-increasing; GIHI delta_ultra >=0. Track per-domain: match_conf distribution, evidence_strength, micro_gate_pass_share_strict, micro_success_block_share, avg_impact_scale_micro.

114e6976-8a59-49ec-8d98-4f617ac462e1.title: Calibrate transfer_confidence to reach FULL match threshold safely
114e6976-8a59-49ec-8d98-4f617ac462e1.description: Add telemetry distribution for transfer_confidence and its factors (similarity, fitness_factor, recency, domain_stability, aging) per domain. Goal: raise median match_conf from ~0.09–0.10 to >=0.11 for a meaningful share without increasing false positives. Consider per-domain normalization (z-score/quantile), and a monotonic calibration map (e.g., isotonic-like piecewise) learned from evidence outcomes.

752ddca9-65bc-4fd3-8bad-7aed42805814.title: Quota diagnostics completeness: log per-tick for all ticks including fallback paths
752ddca9-65bc-4fd3-8bad-7aed42805814.description: confidence_quota_diagnostics currently appears only when quota block executes. Extend campaign.tick payload to always include diagnostics entries per tick (even if quota disabled or no targets), with explicit reason codes: no_low_conf_domains, cooldown_blocked, lock_busy, search_satisfied_quota, forced_eval_used. This prevents silent failures and speeds tuning.

5966cc29-0c0f-4f34-8616-4ef8f6b137f5.title: Campaign auto-advance: self-scheduling tick jobs until stop
5966cc29-0c0f-4f34-8616-4ef8f6b137f5.description:
Problem: campaigns only progress when an external campaign_tick job is enqueued; when queue drains, workers go idle and campaign stalls. Implement auto-advance:
- Add campaign flag `auto_advance` (default true for campaign_create, optional).
- In runCampaignTick (after successful commit), if campaign not stopped/completed and auto_advance=true, enqueue next campaign_tick job automatically with not_before_ts (e.g., now+250ms+jitter) and idempotent job_id (campaign_id + next_tick_index) to avoid duplicates.
- Gate auto-advance on exec queue health: if exec queue_depth>0 or running>0, set not_before_ts further out (e.g., +2s) to prevent contention.
- Ensure lock-busy path keeps auto-advance semantics (requeue keeps next job alive).
Telemetry: add campaign_tick_autoscheduled=true, next_job_id, not_before_ts in campaign.tick record.

4faedb82-fbb4-4a36-9f5e-536f71817fcc.title: Variance governor v2: micro budget + rolling variance + cap shrink on stress
4faedb82-fbb4-4a36-9f5e-536f71817fcc.description:
Burn-in #2 shows micro-impact persists but variance remains ~0.23 and micro share ~0.19. Improve governor:
1) Rolling per-domain variance windows (short/ultra): compute variance over last N applied (or last N transfer events) rather than lifetime to allow recovery; persist `domain_variance_short/ultra`.
2) Micro budget per tick: limit number of micro impacts per tick (global + per-domain). Example: global budget = ceil(0.08 * created_runs) or min(4), per-domain budget = 1. When exhausted, impact_scale=0 but evidence updates continue.
3) Stress cap shrink: if gihi_delta_ultra<0 or meta_state!=stable, set global cap multiplier (e.g., 0.5) for next 3 ticks; combine with per-domain cap.
4) Throttle escalation: if variance_short>VAR_HARD, cooldown=5 (not 3) and also shadow_cap↓ / lambda_d↑ via stabilization_mode.
Telemetry: micro_budget_total, micro_budget_used, micro_budget_exhausted_share, cap_global_multiplier, variance_short/ultra, top variance driver domains with applied share.
